name: community_events
archetype: Community events platform and local activities discovery site
market: Urban dwellers 22-45 looking for local events, classes, workshops, and experiences
density: Medium density. Event cards are compact but visually rich with photography. Calendar widget prominent. Category filtering important. Map view available. Social proof through attendee counts.
nav_style: White nav with colorful logo. Explore, Host an Event, For Organizers, About. Right: location picker (city name with dropdown), search icon, login, Create Event CTA button in vibrant color.
commercial_model: Marketplace. Revenue from ticketing fees (small % of ticket price). Featured event placements. Pro plan for organizers with advanced analytics and promotion tools. No display ads.
color_palette: Vibrant and energetic but accessible. Cobalt blue (#2563EB) as primary brand. White (#FFFFFF) page backgrounds. Light blue (#EFF6FF) for active filter background. Warm coral (#F97316) for featured events and CTAs. Category hex codes: art (#7C3AED purple), music (#EC4899 pink), food (#F97316 orange), sports (#16A34A green), tech (#0EA5E9 sky blue), outdoors (#65A30D yellow-green), wellness (#D97706 amber). Each category chip has its own background color at 15% opacity with the full color as text. The palette communicates community energy.
typography: Nunito or Poppins — rounded, friendly, community-feel. Event titles in 18-20px bold. Date/time in accent color. Location in grey with map pin icon. Price prominently shown. Organizer name small. Attendee count as social proof.

pages.title: Discover Events
pages.description: Location-aware event search hero. Category chips horizontal scroll: All, Music, Art, Food & Drink, Sports, Tech, Outdoors, Wellness. Featured events carousel. This weekend grid. New on the platform section. Popular organizers strip.

pages.title: Explore Events
pages.description: Full event search/browse page with map view toggle. Filters: date, category, price (free vs paid), distance, online/in-person. Event cards in grid with photo, title, date, location, price, attendee count.

pages.title: Event Page
pages.description: Full event page: header photo, event title, date/time, location with map, organizer with follow button, about/description, what's included, schedule, ticket types and prices, attendee photos collage, similar events.

pages.title: Organizer Profile
pages.description: Organizer public profile: name, bio, verified badge, follower count, events hosted count, average rating. Upcoming events grid. Past events with attendance stats. Reviews from attendees. Follow button.

pages.title: Create an Event
pages.description: Event creation form for organizers. Event details: title, description, category, date/time, location or online link. Ticket types with price and quantity. Cover photo upload. Publish vs draft. Preview mode.
